title: Florida House, District 4
what_it_does: Represents District 4 (Part of Okaloosa) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings. Positions have not been researched yet.

candidates.name: Patt Maney
candidates.occupation: Retired U.S. Army brigadier general and former Okaloosa County judge; state representative (first elected 2020)
candidates.background: Maney, of Shalimar, is a retired Army brigadier general and former county judge who was first elected to the House in 2020. He has sponsored a multi-year overhaul of the Baker and Marchman Acts and chairs the Justice Budget Subcommittee.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

property_tax.summary: Voted for HJR 203 in February 2026 but was one of two House Republicans to vote against HJR 1F in June, calling the amendment bad policy that shifts burdens to renters and small businesses.
property_tax.quote: Before we change the way local governments are funded, we need to really give it a lot of analysis

sources.title: Floor Vote for CS/CS/HJR 203, Elimination of Non-school Property Taxes for Homesteads, Florida House
Floor Vote for CS/HJR 1F, Save Our Homes from Excessive Property Taxes (2026 special session), Florida House
Maney explains his painful vote on controversial property tax proposal (Mid Bay News)

abortion.summary: Voted for SB 300 (2023), the Heartbeat Protection Act, which bans most abortions after six weeks of pregnancy. His site pledges to protect the sanctity of life.
abortion.quote: PROTECT the sanctity of life and the rights of our unborn children

sources.title: Floor Vote for SB 300, Pregnancy and Parenting Support (Heartbeat Protection Act), Florida House
Key Priorities — Patt Maney for State Representative

guns.summary: Voted for HB 543 (2023), which allowed carrying a concealed firearm without a license, and for HB 759 (2025) and HB 133 (2026), which would lower the minimum age to buy a rifle or shotgun from 21 to 18. His site supports repealing the red-flag law.
guns.quote: support the repeal of the ill-conceived 'Red Flag Law'

sources.title: Floor Vote for CS/HB 543, Public Safety (permitless concealed carry), Florida House
Floor Vote for HB 759, Minimum Age for Firearm Purchase or Transfer, Florida House
Floor Vote for HB 133, Minimum Age for Firearm Purchase or Transfer, Florida House
Key Priorities — Patt Maney for State Representative

education_choice.summary: Voted for HB 1 (2023), which opened Florida's private-school scholarship (voucher) programs to every K-12 student regardless of family income.

sources.title: Floor Vote for CS/CS/CS/CS/HB 1, Education (universal school choice), Florida House

immigration.summary: Voted for SB 2-C in the February 2025 special session, which created a State Board of Immigration Enforcement, required state and local cooperation with federal immigration enforcement and added state penalties for people in the country illegally.

sources.title: Floor Vote for SB 2-C, Immigration (2025 special session), Florida House
SB 2-C (2025C) Immigration, bill detail, Florida House

veterans.summary: Cites the T. Patt Maney Veterans Treatment Intervention Act and support for military and veteran families.

sources.title: Key Priorities — Patt Maney for State Representative

environment.summary: Pledges to improve infrastructure while protecting the environment.

sources.title: Key Priorities — Patt Maney for State Representative

other_issues.title: Mental health
other_issues.summary: Sponsored HB 7021 (2024), the first major update to the Baker and Marchman Acts in decades, and lists closing gaps in mental health services as a priority.
